newsitem.title: USA: Equifax names Post CFO to succeed Hallman.
newsitem.headline: Equifax names Post CFO to succeed Hallman.

text.p: Equifax Inc said David Post was named chief financial officer, succeeding Donald Hallman, who is retiring December 31 after 26 years with Equifax.
Equifax said Post has been chief financial officer for its Financial Services Group since 1992.
Equifax provides information services to help businesses grant credit, authorizes and processes credit card and check transactions and insures lives and property.
The company, with 14,000 employees, had revenues for the year ended September 30 exceeded $1.7 billion.
